div.div:
مَطْرَدَةٌ A means of driving away, removing, &c.: so in the phrase مَطْرَدَةُ الدَّآءِ عَنِ الجَسَدِ (assumed tropical:) A means of driving away, or removing, disease from the body. (L, from a trad.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) The beaten track; or main part, and middle; of a road; as also ↓ مِطْرَدَةٌ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
